card.name: Digits right before a zero
card.fires_on: A digit (or a broken character) placed just before a zero in a number, such as the 2 in 2006 or 2009, the 3 in 30, or the 4 in 400. It also fires on the broken character before the degree sign in a temperature.

modes.label: Year digit
modes.description: The first digit of a year in the 2000s, right before the zeros, in dates and citations.

modes.label: Dose or time number
modes.description: The leading digit of a round number such as 30 or 400 in dosing or timing text.

modes.label: Broken temperature character
modes.description: A broken byte inside a Fahrenheit temperature written with odd degree signs.

card.writes: It pushes the model away from predicting a zero or zero-like character as the next character.
card.plain: It marks a number whose next character is likely a zero, as in 2006 or 400.
